::: {.hero}
I'm a **Data Science student at BYU–Idaho** (B.S. expected July 2027, minor in Business Analytics). I'm also the **Special Projects Manager at Family Psychological Services**, where I built the monthly ETL and reporting workflow that cleans about 480,000 CRM records and cut report preparation time by 78%.

I like taking messy, real-world data and turning it into clear answers: cleaning it, testing it statistically, modeling it, and building the pipelines that keep it flowing.
